head.description: Capture the essence of a perfect Jersey Shore getaway where the sweet and tangy combination of blue raspberry and lemonade transports you to sun-soaked shores. This vibrant, fruity blue raspberry flavor shines through, perfectly balanced by a burst of zesty lemonade for a refreshingly unique twist on the classic.Flavor Profile:Blue Raspberry Lemonade: A blend of tart, freshly squeezed lemonade and the sweet-tart goodness of juicy blue raspberries, creating a mouthwatering, candy-like flavor that’s both bold and refreshing.Citrus: A hint of lemon adds a zesty zing, enhancing the blue raspberry for an extra kick of citrusy refreshment.Experience:Beach Day Lemonade delivers an uplifting, mood-boosting high that keeps you energized and carefree. Perfect for boardwalk strolls, beach days, or any sun-soaked adventure, it’s your go-to for the ultimate summer vibes.Ideal For:Those seeking a burst of summer energy and a carefree, uplifting vibe. Perfect for daytime adventures whether you’re chasing sunsets, or simply basking in that laid-back, vacation state of mind. Let Beach Day Lemonade transport you to sun-soaked shores where every hit brings a refreshing, feel-good experience.Jersey Smooth is renowned for delivering a refined and consistent cannabis experience. With a commitment to quality, purity, and customer satisfaction, Jersey Smooth offers a carefully curated selection of premium cannabis products. Whether you're a seasoned enthusiast or new to cannabis, Jersey Smooth ensures every session is effortless, enjoyable, and true to its name—smooth.Purchase your Beach Day Lemonade 1g All-in-one at Highway 90, more than just a dispensary—it’s a destination. Located at 90 Old Marlton Pike W in Marlton, NJ, Highway 90 is conveniently situated at the crossroads of Route 70 and Route 73, directly across from Marlton Crossing. Serving the communities of Evesham, Cherry Hill, Voorhees Township, Medford, and Mt. Laurel, Highway 90 provides a welcoming environment for cannabis enthusiasts across the region.At Highway 90, we believe that cannabis is personal, and our knowledgeable team is here to ensure you get exactly what you need. From top-shelf flower to potent concentrates, delicious edibles, and soothing topicals, our selection is curated to elevate your experience. Whether you're a seasoned connoisseur or a first-time buyer, our commitment to quality, education, and exceptional service makes us Marlton’s go-to recreational dispensary.Disposable vaporizers contain concentrated cannabis oil that is heated by an attached battery and inhaled.
